verdict.rationale: Martin is a consumer AI personal-assistant service, and such a service could plausibly publish an API, so the axis applies. Its docs cover only end-user integrations and capabilities (calendar, inbox, Slack, reminders), with no API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file is AI-readable documentation, not an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
